split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before object identity, property synthesis, ivar binding/layout, runtime metadata, dispatch/object inspection, loader workload, runtime acceptance report, generated compile artifact, private query proof, public command surface, public runtime ABI boundary, or closure/provenance row
split_policy.positive_rule: object-model closure rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners over hand-authored fixtures; generated reports, artifacts, descriptors, private snapshots, inspection dumps, labels, and provenance rows are never positive support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: generated reports, compile manifests, runtime-registration descriptors, runtime metadata dumps, packaged proof summaries, private query snapshots, dispatch/object inspection dumps, property/ivar layout snapshots, workload maps, public command wrappers, workflow labels, and closure rows are provenance until a phase owner claims the behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: unresolved dispatch retired route, public reflection ABI widening, public runtime ABI widening, evidence-log support, generated-only support, generated-evidence-log support, source-only reflection truth, probe-local reflection truth, compatibility, gate, retired route, old-mode, migration-only, descriptor-only, manifest-only, query-only, and milestone-local parallel acceptance scaffolding are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.evidence_boundary_rule: parser/sema/lowering/IR/runtime/e2e behavior, object identity, property synthesis, ivar binding/layout, runtime metadata, dispatch/object inspection, loader replay, generated compile artifacts, private query snapshots, public workflow routing, and closure/provenance rows are distinct evidence classes; only the behavior owner may promote a row to positive support
